key_reasoning.reason: AutoPopupManager coordinates three priority-ordered popup flows (onboarding intro, release notes, first-visit page tours) across multiple stores (userStore, appInfoStore, onboardingStore, profileSettingsStore). Two effects manage distinct lifecycle concerns — app-level popups and route-based page tours. Full-stack integration across UI and Service layers with clear but multi-concern responsibility.

Four files changed: new AutoPopupManager.tsx component (260 lines), new test for AutoPopupManager (278 lines), extended appInfo.ts store with isReleasePopupDisabled() method (3 lines added), and extended appInfo.test.ts with 18-test suite validating the override flag logic (68 lines added). Total 67 insertions indicates M-scale changes across test and implementation.
